verdict.rationale: Choosing where data is stored is a fair privacy question for an OS with cloud-connected features such as accounts, Copilot and telemetry, so the axis applies. However, no evidence item documents any region or data-residency selection. The 'Local AI' and local-account items are about other things and do not show a user-selectable storage region.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can choose where my data is stored (region/residency)
